issues.description: The problem statement requires that a Book has an Integer property year ("A struct Book consists of ... an Integer year" - problem_statement.md lines 16-18), but the solution's Book struct does not define a year property (solution_repository/Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift lines 24-33). This is a structural mismatch: students following the specification will add a year field to Book, but the provided reference implementation omits it, which can cause confusion about the intended data model and lead to mismatched initializers/usages in tests or example code.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the Book data model consistent with the problem statement by adding a 'let year: Int' property to the Book struct. Then update all Book initializations (e.g., in assembleBookstore) to provide year values. If the reference solution intentionally omitted year, update the problem statement to remove the year requirement or clarify that year is optional; otherwise, update the solution/template to include 'year' so students and tests share the same structure.
